Decided 2026-10-05 by the sole maintainer (Milo Kang, milocosmopolitan, repository owner) for credential-evidence#235. Question: oauth_token, oauth_signature, placeholders, references, masked displays and prose are not the oauth_token_secret value? Options: flag oauth_token or oauth_signature; or leave the case a draft. Decision: do not flag them as the token secret. Reason: the provider pages document the secret half and its distinction from other credentials, not the confidentiality of oauth_token or of a signature, and the expectation rests on project policy.
